Opened Ministry of Infrastructure page and retrieved full Polish ADR 2025 Tom I PDF. Textually compared 48 selected questions with cited clauses; Ministry states this copy is auxiliary and Dziennik Ustaw remains the legal source, so formal Gazette confirmation and specialist review remain pending.

Part 2: textually compared 48 additional open questions against cited clauses in the full Ministry-hosted Polish ADR 2025 Tom I/II text copies. No conflict found in the reviewed scope; legal Gazette confirmation and independent specialist signoff remain pending.

Part 3: reviewed 48 additional high-risk questions. 47 were textually consistent in scope. ADR-B-0162 remains unresolved pending exact corrigendum comparison for the cited UN 3551/3552 entries and label 9A.

Part 4: textually compared 48 further open questions, including written instructions, emergency response, tunnel/LQ rules, EQ, markings and hazard classes. No confirmed conflict found in scope; specialist review pending.

Part 5: 48 questions screened. 32 textually consistent in scope; 16 remain unresolved because they require direct checking of detailed waste-classification exceptions, a specific loading-prohibition table row, class 7 criteria, or corrigendum applicability to UN 3551.

Opened via web; rejected because content length exceeded 10 MiB. Split ELI scan files were also attempted (02 timed out; 15 exceeded 24 MB limit; 41 exceeded 10 MiB limit). Relevant Gazette page mapping for clauses in batch 0192–0231 not yet established; no official page numbers inferred.

literal_evidence.source: MI ADR 2025 tom I PL
literal_evidence.short_quote: Jeżeli kontenery-cysterny, cysterny przenośne i MEGC nie są oznakowane i zaopatrzone w duże nalepki ostrzegawcze zgodnie z działem 5.3 niniejszego Załącznika, to powinny być one oznakowane i zaopatrzone w duże nalepki ostrzegawcze zgodnie z działem 5.3 Kodeksu IMDG. W takim przypadku, w odniesieniu do oznakowania pojazdu, mają zastosowanie jedynie przepisy podane w 5.3.2.1.1 niniejszego Załącznika. Wymaganie to stosuje się również do przewozu próżnych nieoczyszczonych cystern przenośnych, kontenerów-cystern i MEGC, do czasu ich oczyszczenia.
